install:
set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p "${HOME}/.cache" && chmod 700 "${HOME}/.cache"; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv python install 3.15; fi; if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || [[ "$(node --version)" != v24.* ]]; then python3 tools/local/latest_toolchain.py install-node; fi; BCIR_LOCAL_FULL=1 bash tools/local/setup_mlir.sh; MM_BIN="$(ls -1 "${HOME}/.cache/bcir/tools/micromamba-"* 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)"; if [ -n "${MM_BIN}" ] && [ -x "${MM_BIN}" ]; then MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX="${HOME}/.cache/bcir/mamba" "${MM_BIN}" clean -a -y; fi; M23_ENV="${HOME}/.cache/bcir/mamba/envs/m23"; M23_BIN="${M23_ENV}/bin"; VENV="${HOME}/.cache/bcir/dev-venv"; RUFF_PIN="$(python3 -c 'import tomllib; dev = tomllib.load(open("pyproject.toml", "rb"))["project"]["optional-dependencies"]["dev"]; print(next(e for e in dev if e.startswith("ruff==")))')"; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv venv --allow-existing --python 3.11 "${VENV}"; uv pip install --python "${VENV}/bin/python" "${RUFF_PIN}" "pre-commit>=3.5" "lit" "pip-audit==2.10.1" "build==1.6.0"; uv pip install --python "${VENV}/bin/python" --no-deps -e .; else python3 -m venv "${VENV}"; "${VENV}/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-input "${RUFF_PIN}" "pre-commit>=3.5" "lit" "pip-audit==2.10.1" "build==1.6.0"; "${VENV}/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-input --no-deps -e .; fi; if [ -x "${M23_ENV}/libexec/llvm/FileCheck" ]; then ln -sfn "${M23_ENV}/libexec/llvm/FileCheck" "${M23_BIN}/FileCheck"; fi; if [ -x "${VENV}/bin/lit" ]; then ln -sfn "${VENV}/bin/lit" "${M23_BIN}/lit"; fi; for t in ld.lld lld wasm-ld mlir-opt mlir-translate mlir-tblgen FileCheck; do [ -x "${M23_BIN}/${t}" ] && ln -sfn "${M23_BIN}/${t}" "${M23_BIN}/${t}-23"; done; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "${HOME}/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; cat > "${HOME}/.cache/bcir/env.sh" <<'ENVEOF'
export LLVM_BIN="${HOME}/.cache/bcir/mamba/envs/m23/bin"
export BCIR_NODE_BIN="$(dirname "$(command -v node || echo /usr/local/bin/node)")"
export BCIR_PYTHON_LATEST="$(ls -1d "${HOME}"/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.15*-linux-*/bin/python3.15 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1)"
export MLIR_DIR="${HOME}/.cache/bcir/mamba/envs/m23/lib/cmake/mlir"
export LLVM_DIR="${HOME}/.cache/bcir/mamba/envs/m23/lib/cmake/llvm"
export PIP_AUDIT="${HOME}/.cache/bcir/dev-venv/bin/pip-audit"
case ":${PATH}:" in
  *":${LLVM_BIN}:"*) ;;
  *) export PATH="${LLVM_BIN}:${HOME}/.cache/bcir/dev-venv/bin:${HOME}/.local/bin:${PATH}" ;;
esac
case ":${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}:" in
  *":${HOME}/.cache/bcir/mamba/envs/m23/lib:"*) ;;
  *) export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${HOME}/.cache/bcir/mamba/envs/m23/lib${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}" ;;
esac
ENVEOF
grep -qxF '[ -f "${HOME}/.cache/bcir/env.sh" ] && source "${HOME}/.cache/bcir/env.sh"' "${HOME}/.bashrc" || echo '[ -f "${HOME}/.cache/bcir/env.sh" ] && source "${HOME}/.cache/bcir/env.sh"' >> "${HOME}/.bashrc"
